activity.notes: Thierry of Alsace (French Thierry d'Alsace) became Count of Flanders in 1128 during the succession struggle after the murder of Charles the Good and remained count until his death at Ghent on 4 January 1168. ATLAS models the County of Flanders as the historically specific polity rather than a generic medieval Belgium or France label.

sources.citation_text: The Alsatian historical federation identifies Thierry d'Alsace as Count of Flanders, succeeding in 1128 and dying at Ghent on 4 January 1168.
